merchant.title: Online payments
merchant.text: Connect your own payment gateway account, so your customers (parents, patients, shop customers) pay you directly. The money goes to your account, not ours.
merchant.inherited: These are {company}'s accounts. Branches and departments collect into them; change them at the company.
merchant.none_offered_title: Online payment is not available here yet
merchant.none_offered_text: No payment gateway is open for your country or group yet. Your provider can tell you when it is.
merchant.only_approver: You are the only person here who can approve payment account changes, so your changes take effect {hours} hours after you make them. Everyone who manages the company is told at once.
merchant.pending_after_approval: Takes effect once another person approves it.
merchant.pending_on: Takes effect by itself on {date}, unless someone rejects it.
merchant.pending_yours: This is your change: someone else must approve it.
merchant.check_ok: The gateway accepted the store details {date}.
merchant.check_failed: Last check {date}: the gateway did not accept the details.
merchant.reject_text: The current details stay as they are. The person who asked can try again.
merchant.disable_text: Customers can no longer pay online into it. Payments already made are kept. You can turn it on again later.

dialog.text: Copy the details from your account at the gateway. We check them with the gateway before saving. The password is stored encrypted and never shown again.
dialog.label: Name on screen
dialog.live_closed: Live accounts are not open yet: connect a sandbox account for now.
dialog.new_details_hint: Leave off to change the name only.
dialog.current_password_hint: This decides where your customers' money goes, so we ask for your password.

password.approve_text: From now on, customers' online payments go to store {hint}.
password.enable_text: Customers' online payments go to store {hint} again.
